paths.remote_custom_connector: Claude custom connector pointing at the owner's Qdral relay /mcp endpoint, OAuth through dynamic client registration
paths.claude_code: Claude Code over the local stdio entrypoint (examples/mcp-clients/claude-code.mcp.json) or as a remote connector with a localhost loopback redirect
paths.claude_desktop_local: Claude Desktop over the local stdio entrypoint (examples/mcp-clients/claude-desktop.json) or a packed .mcpb Desktop Extension (examples/mcp-clients/claude-desktop-mcpb-manifest.json)

external_prerequisites: a deployed public HTTPS Qdral relay host operated by the owner
a Claude account on a plan that allows custom connectors, used to add the connector and observe a working session
any Connectors Directory submission is an owner action and is recorded only from observed Anthropic evidence
promotion_rule: No software, test, or CI result promotes any provider-controlled state. They change only by recording directly observed Anthropic evidence in this file through a governed change.
